How to export the ten

Select the ten frames inside the board, then use Export in the right-hand panel — or right-click the selection and choose Export. Each is already set to PDF at 1440 × 480.

Do not use File → Export. That exports every layer in the file that carries an export setting, and this file has fifteen others: the old Carousel frame (PDF) and fourteen Banner N frames (PNG). You would get twenty-six files instead of ten.

The board itself, Hero Shortlist — 10 options · 2026 event archive, also carries a PDF export setting that was already on it. Leave it if you want a single contact sheet alongside the ten; remove it if you do not.

One thing to watch. Hero 04 has the original lamp-lighting photo still sitting underneath the memento photo that now covers it. If that top layer is ever deleted, the frame reverts to the lamp and the name stops matching. The same stacking exists on Hero 05, 06, 09 and 10, where the lower copy is hidden behind an identical or newer crop.
